import itertools

def is_graceful(labels):
    # labels is a list of 8 integers
    # vertices: v00, v01, v10, v11, v20, v21, v30, v31
    # edges:
    edges = [
        (labels[0], labels[1]), # (v00, v01)
        (labels[2], labels[3]), # (v10, v11)
        (labels[4], labels[5]), # (v20, v21)
        (labels[6], labels[7]), # (v30, v31)

        (labels[2], labels[4]), # (v10, v20)
        (labels[3], labels[5]), # (v11, v21)
        (labels[4], labels[6]), # (v20, v30)
        (labels[5], labels[7])  # (v21, v31)
    ]
    edge_labels = [abs(u - v) for u, v in edges]
    if len(set(edge_labels)) != 10:
        return False
    if min(edge_labels) < 1 or max(edge_labels) > 10:
        return False
    return True

import itertools

def solve():
    for labels in itertools.combinations(range(11), 8):
        # We need to check all permutations of these 8 labels
        for p in itertools.permutations(labels):
            if is_graceful(p):
                return p
    return None
